Ingliz tilida bitta o‘zakdan bir nechta so‘z yasaladi: employ (fe’l) → employment (bandlik), employer (ish beruvchi), employee (xodim), unemployed (ishsiz). O‘zbek tilida -lik, -chi, -li kabi qo‘shimchalar shu vazifani bajaradi, ingliz tilida esa qaysi qo‘shimcha kelishini so‘z bilan birga yodlash kerak: develop → development, decide → decision, aware → awareness, able → ability.
Ingliz tilida gapirishdan qo‘rqasizmi? Sellzen ovozli ustozi bilan har kuni 5 daqiqa gaplashing — xatolaringizni o‘zbekcha tushuntiradi va eslab qoladi. Sinab ko‘ring: {0}
Ingliz tilida sifat otdan OLDIN keladi (o‘zbekchadagi kabi): a big city, an old man, a beautiful park.
Ingliz tilida “men talabaman” degan gapda ham fe’l bo‘lishi shart. Bu fe’l — “to be”. U egaga qarab uch xil bo‘ladi: am, is, are.
Ingliz tilida “men, sen, u, biz, ular” so‘zlari: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. I doim katta harf bilan yoziladi — gap o‘rtasida ham: My friend and I…
Ingliz tilini nima uchun o‘rganayotganingizni va buning uchun nima qilayotganingizni yozing (in order to, so that, so as not to).
Ingliz tilini noldan boshlaysiz: harflarni o‘qish, ismingizni harflab aytish, qiyin tovushlar va sonlar.
Inglizcha so‘zni, keyin uning tarjimasini bosing.
Inglizchada o‘tgan zamon “masofa” yaratadi va iltimosni yumshatadi. Hozirgi zamonda: “I wonder if you can help.” Muloyimroq: “I was wondering if you could help.” (vaqt — hozir!)
Inglizchada qush va tosh: kill two birds with one stone.

Inglizchada to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri “No, you are wrong” deyish qo‘pol eshitiladi. Muloyim e’tiroz odatda qisman qo‘shilishdan boshlanadi: I see what you mean, but …; That’s a good point, but …; I’m not sure about that. To‘liq qo‘shilish: Exactly! / You’re right. / I totally agree.
Inkor gapga “men ham … emas”: Neither + yordamchi + I. “I don’t like rain.” — “Neither do I.” “I haven’t been there.” — “Neither have I.” Og‘zaki: “Me neither.”
Inkor maqsad — so as not to.
Inkor maqsad: so as not to / in order not to + fe’l: “We left early so as not to miss the train.” (“to not miss” ham uchraydi, lekin yozma ishda yaxshisi so as not to.)
Inkor odatda think ga o‘tadi: I don’t think…

Inkor old qo‘shimchalari “-siz, -mas, no-” ma’nosini beradi: un- eng keng tarqalgan (unlikely, unusual), dis- ko‘pincha fe’l va sifatlar bilan (disagree, dishonest). in- keyingi harfga qarab o‘zgaradi: p, b, m oldida im- (impossible, impatient), l oldida il- (illegal), r oldida ir- (irregular, irresponsible). O‘zbek o‘quvchilarda “unpossible”, “inlegal”, “unresponsible” kabi xatolar ko‘p uchraydi.
Inkor think da: I don’t think it will…
Inkor think ga o‘tadi: I don’t think…
Inkor uchun “not” qo‘shiladi: is not = isn’t, are not = aren’t, am not = ’m not (“amn’t” degan shakl yo‘q).
Inkor va savol: didn’t use to, Did you use to …? (“d” siz: use to). “I didn’t used to” — xato.
Inkor yoki cheklovchi so‘z gap boshida kelganda yordamchi fe’lni egadan oldin qo‘yib, ta’kidli gap tuzasiz.
Inkor: Had it not been for …
Inkor: I don’t understand. “not” yoki “no” yolg‘iz ishlatilmaydi.
Inkor: I’m not going to…, She isn’t going to… Savol: Are you going to…? What are you going to do?
Inkor: can’t (cannot). Savol: Can you speak Russian? — Yes, I can. / No, I can’t.

Inkor: couldn’t (could not): I couldn’t sleep last night. Savol: Could you swim as a child? — Yes, I could. / No, I couldn’t. O‘zbekchadagi “qila olmadim” ham, “qila olmasdim” ham couldn’t bilan beriladi. Bir martalik muvaffaqiyat haqida (“nihoyat topa oldik”) inglizlar ko‘pincha managed to deyishadi: We managed to find the path. Inkorda esa couldn’t har doim to‘g‘ri.
Inkor: didn’t + oddiy fe’l: I didn’t see him. Qisqa javob: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Inkor: don’t = do not, doesn’t = does not. Qisqa javob: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn’t.
Inkor: don’t agree (am not agree emas).
Inkor: not to + fe’l: “Don’t touch it!” → They told us not to touch it. (“told us don’t touch” — xato.)
Inkor: shouldn’t: You shouldn’t eat so much sugar. Savol: Should I call him? What should I do?
Inkor: that he not be late (doesn’t emas). Majhul: that the report be sent today.
Inkor: was not = wasn’t, were not = weren’t. Savol so‘zi bilan: “Where were you?” “How was the trip?”
Inkorda ravish won’t dan oldin: probably won’t.
Insho yodlamang. Tuzilmani yodlang va o‘z g‘oyangiz bilan to‘ldiring.
Intervyu va suhbat: kim nima qildi, nima haqida gaplashyapsiz, odatda va hozir nima bo‘lyapti.
Inversiya: 'rarely', 'seldom', 'never' gap boshida kelsa yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin chiqadi.
Inversiya: Never have I…, Not only…
Ish haftasi, motivatsiya, kasbiy charchoq, ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanati.
Ish joyi va o‘qishdagi qoidalar, majburiyatlar, o‘tmishdagi odatlar va kelajak maqsadlari haqida gapirish (intervyu va IELTS Speaking Part 1 uchun ham).
Ish joyidagi nizoni tasvirlang: kim kimni nimada aybladi, kim nima uchun kechirim so‘radi, nima nimaga to‘sqinlik qildi (kamida 4 ta fe’l + predlog).
Ish joyidagi yig‘ilishni rahbarga yetkazish: kim nimani taklif qildi, nimani rad etdi, nima bajarilishi shart.
Ish va kundalik suhbatlarda ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar kabi idiomalarni o‘rinli ishlatish va ularni yozma ishda qachon ishlatmaslikni bilish.

Ish va o‘qish haqidagi suhbatlarda rejalar haqida gapiradigan idiomalar juda ko‘p ishlatiladi: the ball is in your court (endi navbat sizda — qaror yoki keyingi qadam sizdan), up in the air (hali hal qilinmagan, noaniq), back to the drawing board (reja ishlamadi — boshidan boshlaymiz).
Ish yoki o‘qish kunlari va dam olish kunlari nima kiyasiz? Qanday kiyimlaringiz bor? (wear va have got)
Ish yozishmalarida tanqidni yumshatadi: “There may be some room for improvement.” (= ancha yaxshilash kerak). Ma’noni to‘g‘ri tushunish C2 uchun muhim: so‘zlovchi aslida nima demoqchi?
Ish-harakatni bajaruvchi emas, natija muhim bo'lsa majhul nisbat: was/were + V3.
Ish-harakatni bajaruvchi noma’lum yoki muhim bo‘lmaganda be + 3-shakl bilan passiv gap tuzasiz (turli zamonlarda).
Ishga ariza bermoqchi edim, lekin muddat o‘tib ketgan ekan.
Ishga yoki o‘qishga qanday borasiz va qancha vaqt ketadi? Oilangizdagi bir kishi qanday boradi?
Ishga yoki o‘qishga qanday borishingizni by bus / on foot bilan aytasiz va How do you get to…? deb so‘raysiz.
Ishimda menga eng yoqadigan narsa — odamlar.
Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida 3 ta gap: for, since va already / yet / just ishlating.
Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingizdagi muammo haqida 3–4 gap yozing: kamida bitta inkor old qo‘shimchali sifat (un-, dis-, im-, il-, ir-) va bitta mis- / over- / under- / re- li fe’l yoki sifat.
Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingizdagi qoidalar haqida yozing: majburiyat (have to / must), taqiq (mustn’t) va shart emas (don’t have to).
Ishni o‘zingiz emas, boshqa odam bajarganini have/get + narsa + V3 bilan aytasiz.
Ishni usta, xizmatchi kabi boshqa odam bajarsa: have + narsa + V3. I had my hair cut. (Sochimni o‘zim kesmadim — sartaroshda oldirdim.)
Ishontirish usullari: ritorik savol, uchlik, qarama-qarshilik
Ism aytishda 'My name is ...' qolipi ishlatiladi.
Ism doim katta harf (capital letter) bilan boshlanadi.
Ism katta harf bilan yoziladi — ko‘z tez ilg‘aydi.

Ismni so‘rashganda ko‘pincha “How do you spell it?” (Qanday yoziladi?) deyishadi. Siz harflarni birma-bir aytasiz: “A-Z-I-Z”. Ikkita bir xil harf ketma-ket kelsa, “double” deyish mumkin: Anna — A, double N, A.
Issiqqa chidamli marjonlar sinovda, lekin emissiyani kamaytirish shart
Istisnolar: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard (hardly emas — u “deyarli yo‘q” degani!), late → late.
It + is said / believed / thought / reported + that + gap: It is believed that the painting is a copy.
It could be argued that — passiv qolip.
It could be argued that — qarshi fikrni kiritadi.
It is / It was … that / who …
It is / was + ta’kidlangan qism + that / who …
It is essential / important / vital that + ega + asosiy shakl: It is essential that every student attend.
It is essential / vital that + ega + fe’l
It is important to note that… → (o‘chiring)
It seems to me that… — menimcha.
It was one of the most ______ days of my life. (esda qolarli)
It-cleft har doim It is / It was bilan.

It-cleft: ta’kidlanadigan qism It is / It was bilan oldinga chiqariladi, qolgani that (odam bo‘lsa who ham mumkin) bilan keladi: My brother broke the window. → It was my brother who broke the window (boshqasi emas).
Ito goes ___, arguing that homework may actually harm motivation. (yanada uzoqroq)
It’s (high / about) time + ega + Past Simple: hozir bo‘lishi kerak bo‘lgan ish hali bo‘lmagan. It’s time we left. (Allaqachon ketishimiz kerak edi.)
It’s time + to + fe’l — oddiy ma’noda: It’s time to go.
I’m really ______ on cooking these days. (qiziqaman)
J — “jey”, G — “ji:”. Bu ikkisini ko‘p adashtirishadi.
Jadval va ustunli diagrammada har bir sonni alohida tasvirlash — xato. Ma’lumotni guruhlang: eng kattalar, eng kichiklar, o‘xshashlar. Har abzatsda bitta guruh.
Jamoalar yaxshi muloqot qilsa, masofaviy ish samarali bo‘ladi.
Jamoat transporti arzonroq, tezroq va ekologik tozaroq.
Jamoatchilikning sog‘lom ovqatlanish haqidagi xabardorligi oshdi.
Jarayon (process): kim qilgani muhim emas, nima qilinishi muhim — shuning uchun MAJHUL NISBAT: The leaves are picked, then they are dried. Ketma-ketlik: First, Next, After that, Once…, Finally.
Jarayonni majhul nisbat va ketma-ketlik so‘zlari bilan, xaritadagi o‘zgarishlarni esa was replaced by, was built kabi tuzilmalar bilan tasvirlaysiz.
Jarima yo‘q — shuning uchun taxmin qilish foydali.
Javob berishdan oldin uzoq o‘ylayapsiz. Qisqa "Well, ..." bilan boshlab vaqt yutish mumkin.
Javob o‘ylash uchun tabiiy iboralardan foydalanasiz va so‘zni bilmasangiz, uni boshqacha tushuntirib davom etasiz.
Javob varag‘iga ko‘chirish uchun alohida vaqt BERILMAYDI (Listening’dan farqi). Shuning uchun javobni darhol to‘g‘ri yozib boring.
Javob: True, False yoki Not Given
Javobingizni inglizcha yozing... (abzatslarni bo‘sh qator bilan ajrating)
Javoblar qisqa. Har savolga 2–3 gap bilan javob bering va sababini qo‘shing.
Javoblar, qiyinlik va unutish hisobga olinadi.
Javoblarni ko‘chirish uchun qo‘shimcha vaqt yo‘q.
Javobni 3 qismda quring: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob → sabab → qisqa misol.
Jazo va reabilitatsiya, jinoyatchilik, jamiyatga qaytish.
Jonlar tugadi — keling, qoidani qayta ko‘rib chiqamiz
Jonli ovozli suhbat hozir ishlamayapti — oddiy ovozli rejimda davom etamiz: siz gapirasiz, Sellzen matn va ovoz bilan javob beradi.
Jonli suhbat ohangi: qisqartmalar, “well”, “honestly” kabi so‘zlar. Tabiiy ritmni qayta ishlashga urining.

Joy predloglari (in, on, under) narsa QAYERDA turganini bildiradi. Harakat predloglari esa QAYERGA yoki QAYERDAN o‘tib borilganini ko‘rsatadi: We walked into the forest. O‘zbek tilida bu ma’no ko‘pincha qo‘shimcha bilan beriladi (o‘rmonga, ko‘prikdan, tunnel orqali), ingliz tilida esa fe’ldan keyin predlog keladi.
Joy ravishi oldinga chiqsa, fe’l ega oldiga o‘tishi mumkin (adabiy uslub): On the hill stood an old castle.
Joyda nima borligini there is / there are bilan aytasiz va some / any ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz.
Joyi: oddiy fe’ldan OLDIN (I always drink tea), lekin to be dan KEYIN (She is always late).
Joylar odatda tartib bilan tushuntiriladi, xuddi savollar tartibida. Bitta joyni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, qotib qolmang — keyingi joyning tavsifiga e’tibor bering.
Juda ko‘p urinish. Bir ozdan keyin qayta urinib ko‘ring.
Juda ko‘p “um” deyapsiz. Qisqa pauza qilib ko‘ring.
Juda uzun gapirmang — 1-qism savollari ko‘p, imtihonchi keyingisiga o‘tishi kerak. Savolning zamoniga mos javob bering: “Did you…?” — o‘tgan zamon; “Do you…?” — hozirgi oddiy.
Juda … ki: too young to, old enough to
Juft iboralar: sooner or later, pros and cons
Juma kuni kechqurun yo‘llar gavjum bo‘lishi ehtimoli katta.
Juma kunlari hammamiz birga o‘tirib palov yerdik.
Kafe yoki do‘konda muloyim buyurtma berasiz: I’d like…, Can I have…?, Would you like…?
Kafeda buyurtma berish va nimani yoqtirishingizni aytish: “I’d like a tea, please.”
Kafeda: I’d like… / Can I have…?
Kafedagi qisqa suhbatni yozing: ofitsiant taklif qiladi, siz 2 ta narsa buyurtma qilasiz.
Kalit so‘z — faqat joy; javob butun gapda.
Kalit so‘zlar audioda paraphrase bilan keladi: savolda “cost” bo‘lsa, audioda “price”, “fee” yoki “you’ll pay” eshitiladi. Shuning uchun kalit so‘zning sinonimlarini ham o‘ylab qo‘ying.
Kalit so‘zni topganingizda, butun gapni o‘qing.
Kalkulyator qoidalari va savollar soni bo‘yicha domenlar ulushi bu yerda keltirilmadi (rasmiy sahifadan to‘liq o‘qib bo‘lmadi).
Kampaniya ruhiy salomatlik haqida xabardorlikni oshirishni maqsad qilgan.
Karimovaning so‘rovnomasini davom ettirib, Ito qirq nafar o‘qituvchi bilan suhbat o‘tkazdi.
Karta bilan to‘lash: pay by card.
Kartochka bo‘yicha 1 daqiqada kalit so‘zli reja tuzib, 2 daqiqa davomida tartib bilan, o‘tgan zamonda gapirasiz.

Kartochkada mavzu va 3–4 ta yo‘naltiruvchi savol bo‘ladi: “Describe a place you visited. You should say: where it was, when you went, what you did, and explain why you liked it.” Shu savollar — tayyor rejangiz.
Kasal do‘stingizga 3 ta maslahat yozing (should / shouldn’t).
Kasb oldidan a/an qo'yiladi. 'engineer' unli tovush bilan boshlangani uchun 'an' ishlatiladi.
Kasb yoki shaxs turi oldidan 'a' qo'yiladi: a student. O'zbekchada artikl yo'q, shuning uchun uni unutish odatiy xato.
Kasblar oldida a yoki an ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz va my, your, his, her bilan egalikni bildirasiz.
Kasblar: a / an va my / your
Katta an’anaviy to‘ylar bugun ham to‘g‘rimi?

Katta ehtimol: be likely to, may well / could well + fe’l (“The meeting may well run late.”), there’s a good / every chance (that). Kichik ehtimol: be unlikely to, there’s little chance, I doubt whether.
Katta farq: far / much / considerably / significantly + qiyosiy: “far more expensive”, “considerably faster”. Kichik farq: slightly / marginally / a little: “marginally cheaper”.

Katta harf bilan yoziladi: gap boshi, I (doim!), ismlar, shahar va davlatlar, tillar va millatlar, hafta kunlari va oylar: I live in Samarkand. I speak Uzbek. My birthday is in May. O‘zbekchada “dushanba”, “o‘zbek tili” kichik harf bilan yoziladi — inglizchada esa Monday, Uzbek.
Katta harf, nuqta va and / but / because dan to‘g‘ri foydalanib, o‘zingiz haqingizda 4–5 gapli xat yozasiz.
Kech javob uchun uzr — imtihonlarim sabab band edim.
Kecha biz ko‘rgan film juda maftunkor edi.
Kecha bo‘lgan yig‘ilishni rahbarga yetkazing: kim nimani taklif qildi, rad etdi, va’da berdi (kamida 3 xil reporting verb).
Kecha darsda bormidingiz? — Yo‘q, yo‘q edim.
Kecha kimdir sizga aytgan 3 ta gapni o‘zlashtirma gap bilan yetkazing (said / told / asked).
Kecha nima qilganingiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing (to‘g‘ri fe’llar, -ed).
Kecha qayerda edingiz va qanday edi? 3 ta gap yozing (was / were).
Kecha sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqchi edim, lekin vaqtim yetmadi.
Kecha soat 8 da oilangizdagi har kim nima qilayotgan edi? 3–4 gap yozing.
Kecha soat o‘nda film ko‘rayotgan edim.
Kecha tashqariga chiqish uchun juda charchagan edim.
Kechagi kuningizni 4–5 gap bilan hikoya qiling: First, Then, After that, Finally.
Kechagi uchun uzr. Juda band edim.
Kechagi voqea haqida 2 ta ega savoli (Who…?) va 2 ta to‘ldiruvchi savoli (What did…?) yozing.
Kechikib qolgan bir voqeani yozing: siz yetib borganingizda nimalar allaqachon bo‘lib bo‘lgan edi? (had + V3, kamida 2 marta)
Kechirasiz, bugun sizga yordam bera olmayman.
Kechirasiz, eng yaqin dorixona qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?
Kechirasiz, miyam bir soniya o‘chib qoldi. Qaytadan ayting!
Kechirasiz, u yig‘ilishda. Unga biror narsa aytib qo‘yaymi?
Keksalar ko‘pincha gazeta o‘qiydi, yoshlar esa yangiliklarni internetdan oladi.
Kelajak haqida gapirganda 'would' (I'd hike, I'd try) ishlating.
Kelajak haqida gapirsak ham, when / as soon as / until / before / after / once dan keyingi qismda will ishlatilmaydi: “I’ll call you when I arrive.” (when I will arrive — xato.)
Kelajak haqida ma’lumot yo‘q → NOT GIVEN.
Kelajak haqidagi taxminlaringizni definitely, probably, be likely / unlikely to bilan ishonch darajasiga qarab ifodalaysiz va so‘z tartibini to‘g‘ri qo‘yasiz.
Kelajak rejalar uchun 'I'd like to' / 'I'm planning to' ishlating.
Kelajak rejalaringiz, bashoratlar va real shartlar haqida gapirish: ish, o‘qish, sayohat.
Kelajak vaqt gaplari: when I arrive (will arrive emas)
Kelajak vaqti bilan Present Continuous — reja.

Kelajak: ishonch darajasiga qarab: will definitely (aniq), are likely to (ehtimoli katta), might / could (ehtimol), I imagine / I suspect (shaxsiy taxmin). “I think will…” emas — “I think people will…”.
Kelajak: will be doing va will have done
Kelajakda haqiqatan bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan shart: If it rains, we will stay at home. (Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz.)
Kelajakda shaharlar yanada yashilroq bo‘lishi ehtimoli katta.
Kelajakda shahringiz qanday o‘zgaradi? 4–5 gap: kamida 3 xil ehtimol darajasi (bound to, likely to, may well, unlikely to).
Kelajakdagi davomiylik (holat fe’li be) — will have been.
Kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtda davom etayotgan ishni va o‘sha vaqtgacha tugagan ishni farqlaysiz.
Kelasi dam olish kunlari nima qilishingiz mumkin? Aniq bilmaysiz: 3–4 gap (may / might / could, bittasi inkor).
Kelasi oyga kelib, ingliz tilini o‘rganayotganimga besh yil bo‘ladi.
Kelasi yil hayotingizda nima bo‘lishini taxmin qiling: 3–4 gap yozing va turli ishonch darajalarini ishlating (definitely, probably, probably won’t, be likely / unlikely to).
Kelasi yil rejalaringizni (going to) va bitta bashoratingizni (will) yozing.
Kelasi yil shu kuni nima qilayotgan bo‘lasiz va yil oxirigacha nimalarga erishgan bo‘lasiz? will be + -ing va will have + V3 ni ishlating.
Kelasi yildagi rejangizni yozing: nima bo‘lgandan keyin nima qilasiz (when, as soon as, once, until — will bilan birga).
Kelasi yilgi 3 ta rejangiz haqida yozing (going to; bittasi inkor bo‘lsin).
Kelasi zamon majhul nisbati: will be + V3.
Kelasi zamon passiv: will be built.
Kelasi zamon: going to yoki will?
Kelasi zamon: will + fe'l yoki be going to.
Kelganda kechqurun — Good evening. Good night — faqat xayrlashganda.
Kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan reja uchun ham Present Continuous ishlatiladi: I’m meeting Aziz at six tomorrow. (Biz kelishganmiz.)

Kelishuv: Both Hall (2021) and Ito (2023) argue that…; Ito’s findings are consistent with / echo those of Hall; There is broad consensus that…; Khan concurs. Qarama-qarshilik: In contrast to Hall, Ito found…; Whereas Hall emphasises X, Ito focuses on Y. Davom ettirish: Building on Hall’s work, Ito shows…; Khan goes further, arguing that…
Keng tarqalgan idiomalarni kontekstdan tushunasiz va ularni o‘rinli (ortiqcha emas) ishlatasiz.
Kengash taklifni kelasi oy ko‘rib chiqadi.

Kerakli so‘zlar: opposite (qarshisida), next to / beside (yonida), between (orasida), in the corner (burchakda), at the far end (eng oxirida), on your left/right (chap/o‘ng tomoningizda), go past (yonidan o‘tib), turn left (chapga buriling).
Kesim qismi oldinga: So great was the demand that tickets sold out in minutes. Such was his anger that he left.
Keskin hazil, roast, jahl va yengil so‘kish — faqat ingliz tilingizdagi xatolar ustidan. Shaxsingizni hech qachon kamsitmaydi.
Keskin o‘sishdan so‘ng, oxirgi chorakda savdo barqarorlashdi.
Keyingi hafta uchun kelishilgan 3 ta rejangizni yozing (Present Continuous + vaqt).
Keyingi ishga o‘tish — go on + to.
Keyingi o‘lchov: {0}. Har 2 haftada bir marta — shunda o‘sish ishonchli ko‘rinadi.
Keyingi pog‘onaga o‘tish: shu darajadagi {0} ta testdan 70% va undan yuqori. Bajarildi: {1}/{0}
Keyingi signpostni kuting va davom eting.
Kichik joy yoki nuqta (airport, station) bilan 'arrive at' ishlatiladi.
Kichik ukangizga hayotiy maslahatlar yozing (4–5 gap): whatever, however + sifat, whenever / wherever.
Kichikligimda bobom har kecha bizga ertak aytib berardi.
Kim bajarishi muhim bo‘lmasa yoki noma’lum bo‘lsa majhul tanlanadi. Muhim bo‘lsa — by bilan: “The documents must be signed by the director.”
Kim berdi? — ega savoli: Who gave…?
Kim ifloslangan havodan nafas olishni tanlardi?
Kim uchun ekanini for bilan qo‘shish mumkin: “The box is too heavy for me to carry.” “The water is warm enough for the children to swim.”
Kimdir bo‘sh uyda radioni yoqib qoldirgan ekan.
Kimdir, hech narsa, hamma joy: some-/any-/no-/every-
Kimningdir narsasi: ism + ’s + narsa: Ali’s phone (Alining telefoni), my mother’s car. Ko‘plikdagi -s bilan tugagan so‘zda faqat apostrof: my parents’ house.
Kinoga yetib borganimizda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.
Kinoteatrga boruvchilar soni asta-sekin kamayib bordi.
Kinoyali tomoni shundaki, chekishga qarshi kampaniyani tamaki kompaniyasi moliyalashtirgan.
Kirish ma’lumoti eskirgan — qaytadan urinib ko‘ring

Kirish: 1) savolni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta yozing (paraphrase), 2) thesis — aniq pozitsiya va esse rejasi: “I completely agree because…”, “This essay will argue that…”. Savolni so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirish — ball bermaydi.
Kirishdan keyin (yoki oxirida) — ko‘pincha kirishdan keyin.
Kiyim do‘konida sotuvchi bilan qisqa suhbat yozing: narx, o‘lcham va to‘lovni so‘rang.
Kiyim nomlarini bilasiz va odatda nima kiyishingizni wear (Present Simple) va have got bilan aytasiz.
Kiyimingiz BORligini have got bilan aytamiz: I have got a new jacket. She has got two dresses. wear — kiyish odati, have got — egalik. “Hozir kiyib turibman” (I am wearing…) A2 da o‘rganiladi.
Ko'chirma gapda savol tartibi darak gap tartibiga o'tadi (did yo'q), zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi: lived.
Ko'plik ot (five students) bilan 'There are' ishlatiladi.
Kohorta — tanlangan davrda ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan o‘quvchilar. Har bir qadam: shu o‘quvchilardan nechtasi (noyob) ro‘yxatdan keyin istalgan vaqtda bajargan.
Kohorta: shu davrda ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan {0} o‘quvchi

Kollokatsiya — birga ishlatiladigan so‘zlar. Grammatik to‘g‘ri, lekin g‘ayritabiiy birikma (“make a crime”, “do a mistake”) yuqori darajada xato hisoblanadi va IELTS Lexical Resource bahosini tushiradi.
Kompaniya kechikish uchun to‘liq javobgarlikni o‘z zimmasiga oldi.
Kompaniya xodimlar haftada ikki kun uydan ishlashi mumkin bo‘lgan tizimni joriy etdi.
Kompaniyani kuzatib, yoshlar bilan ishlashini yoqtirgan
Kosmik missiya markazi ekipaj bilan aloqada: kislorod bosimi tushmoqda (ilmiy-fantastika uslubi).
Ko‘chamizda muzey bor. O‘sha muzey juda eski.
Ko‘changizdagi bitta joyni tasvirlang: avval a/an bilan tanishtiring, keyin the bilan davom eting (3 gap).
Ko‘chani kesib o‘tayotganimda ustozimni ko‘rib qoldim.
Ko‘ngilsiz hodisa: had her bag stolen.
Ko‘nikkan: be used to / get used to
Ko‘p chekish yurak kasalliklari bilan chambarchas bog‘liq.

Ko‘p fe’llar ma’lum predlog bilan keladi va o‘zbekchadan tarjima qilib bo‘lmaydi. fe’l + kishi + predlog: accuse sb of (ayblamoq), blame sb for, congratulate sb on, prevent / stop sb from, thank sb for, remind sb of, protect sb from.
Ko‘p fe’llar predlog bilan keladi: listen to, look for, talk about, wait for, think about, come from.
Ko‘p ishlatiladigan fe’llar -ed olmaydi, ularning o‘tgan shaklini yodlash kerak: go → went, have → had.
Ko‘p ishlatiladigan sifatlardan keyin to‘g‘ri predlogni (at, of, about, with, for) tanlab, his-tuyg‘ularingizni xabarda ifodalaysiz.

Ko‘p ishlatiladiganlar: a blessing in disguise (avvaliga yomon, keyin foydali chiqqan narsa), cut corners (ishni yengil-yelpi qilmoq), on the fence (ikkilanib turgan), the tip of the iceberg (muammoning ko‘rinib turgan kichik qismi), a steep learning curve (qisqa vaqtda ko‘p narsani o‘rganish zarurati — boshida qiyin).
Ko‘p ishlatiladiganlar: a cup of tea, a glass of juice, a piece of cake, a slice of bread, a kilo of meat, a packet of biscuits, a loaf of bread.
Ko‘p mamlakatlarda hamshiralar mehnatiga yarasha maosh olmaydi.
Ko‘p narsa — they (odamlar uchun ham, narsalar uchun ham).
Ko‘p odam elektromobil oldi → Elektromobil savdosi yuqori bo‘ldi.
Ko‘p odamlar yaxshiroq ish imkoniyatlari tufayli shaharlarga ko‘chdi.

Ko‘p savol turlarida javoblar matndagi tartibda keladi: 5-savol javobi 4-savoldan keyin turadi. Bu qoida qidirishni tezlashtiradi. Har bir to‘g‘ri javob — 1 ball; noto‘g‘ri javob ball olib ketmaydi, shuning uchun hech qachon bo‘sh qoldirmang.
Ko‘p shaharlar velosiped yo‘laklari qurmoqda. Bu tendensiya davom etsa kerak.

Ko‘p uchraydigan qoliplar: well / badly + V3 (well-known, badly-paid), ot + -ing (time-consuming, record-breaking), sifat + ot-ed (open-minded, short-sighted, kind-hearted), son + ot (a three-day trip).

Ko‘p uchraydigan xato — o‘tmish haqida gapirib, can ishlatish: “Yesterday I can’t find my keys.” To‘g‘risi: Yesterday I couldn’t find my keys. Eslatma: Could you help me? kabi savol iltimos ham bo‘lishi mumkin — buni keyingi bo‘limda o‘rganamiz.
Ko‘p uyqu emas, sifatli va muntazam uyqu muhim
Ko‘p va katta dalil — kuchli fe’l: demonstrated.
Ko‘p va oz: a lot of, a few, a little
Ko‘p xato: bir abzatsda 3–4 fikrni sanab, hech birini rivojlantirmaslik. Kamroq fikr, lekin chuqurroq — yuqori ball. Ikki asosiy abzats (har biri 80–100 so‘z) Task 2 uchun yetarli.
Ko‘pchilik qancha sport bilan shug‘ullanishini oshirib baholaydi.
Ko‘pchilik savollar test shaklida; Math’dagi ba’zi savollarda javobni o‘zingiz kiritasiz (student-produced response).
Ko‘pincha ko‘ngilsiz hodisalar uchun ham ishlatiladi: She had her bag stolen. (Sumkasini o‘g‘irlatdi — o‘zi xohlamagan.)
Ko‘pincha sifat + -ly: slow → slowly, quiet → quietly, easy → easily (y → ily). Ravish odatda fe’l va to‘ldiruvchidan keyin turadi: She speaks English well.
Ko‘plab ota-onalar internetdagi xavfsizlikdan qattiq xavotirda.
Ko‘plab yoshlar qishloqlarni tark etmoqda. Bu tendensiya mahalliy hokimiyatni xavotirga solmoqda.
Ko‘plikda idish so‘zi -s oladi, narsa o‘zgarmaydi: two bottles of water (two bottle of waters emas).
Ko‘prik XII asrda qurilgan deb taxmin qilinadi.
Ko‘prik ustidan bir tomondan ikkinchisiga — across.
Ko‘proq dam olishing kerak — juda charchagan ko‘rinasan.
Ko‘rinib turgan bashorat — is going to.
Ko‘rinib turgan dalil: is going to.

Ko‘rsatmani diqqat bilan o‘qing: “ONE WORD ONLY” — faqat bitta so‘z; “NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS” — bitta yoki ikkita; “AND/OR A NUMBER” — son ham yozish mumkin. Chegaradan oshsa — javob noto‘g‘ri, hatto ma’nosi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham.

Kuchli (extreme) sifatlar allaqachon “juda” ma’nosini beradi: freezing (= very cold), exhausted, huge, amazing, terrible, furious, tiny. Ular bilan absolutely, completely, totally ishlatiladi: absolutely freezing. “Very freezing” — xato.

Kuchli insho faqat o‘z fikrini takrorlamaydi — qarshi fikrni ham adolatli ko‘rsatadi va nega u yetarli emasligini tushuntiradi. Tuzilma uch qadamli: (1) qarshi fikr — It could be argued that… / Opponents of this view claim that…; (2) uni qisman tan olish — Admittedly, … / This argument has some merit; (3) raddiya — However, this overlooks… / This view fails to recognise… / This is not necessarily the case, as…
Kuchli kollokatsiyalar va aniq so‘z tanlash
Kuchli taxmin (deduction): dalil bor, shuning uchun 'must be'.
Kuchli ta’kid: the very + ot (aynan o‘sha): This is the very book I was looking for. Inkorni kuchaytirish: not … at all, by no means.
Kuchli tomoni: murakkab g‘oyani sodda xabarga aylantirish
Kuldik, chunki rosa qo‘rqib ketgan edik.
Kulib, hazillashib gaplashadi va sizni ko‘proq gapirishga undaydi.
Kun tartibingiz haqida 4 ta gap yozing (usually / always / never va soat bilan).
Kun tartibingiz, odatlaringiz va oila a’zolaringiz nima qilishi haqida gapirish.
Kun vaqtiga mos salomlashasiz, please / thank you / sorry deysiz va tushunmasangiz qayta so‘raysiz.
Kundalik iboralarni eshiting: kechirim so‘rash va muammoni xushmuomalalik bilan aytish.
Kundalik iboraviy fe’llar: give up, find out
Kundalik mavzularda oddiy gaplashasiz. Grammatika asoslarini mustahkamlaysiz.
Kuniga 20 daqiqa ingliz tilida o‘qing. Kichik kunlik odat hafta oxiridagi marafondan kuchli.
Kuniga AI ustoz matnli xabarlari (bitta o‘quvchi)
Kuniga bepul yangi darslar (har bir kurs)
Kunlar oldidan 'on' ishlatiladi (on Friday, on 5 May).
Kurs shunchalik mashhur ediki, ikkinchi guruh ochildi.
Kursning yakuni: akademik munosabat bildirish, manbalarni aniq fe’llar bilan baholash va fikrni mahorat bilan qayta ifodalash.
Kutilmagan bir tajribangiz haqida tahliliy paragraf yozing: what-gap, the fact that va whether bilan.
Kutilmagan voqeani yozing: siz nimadir qilayotgan edingiz va birdan nimadir bo‘ldi (when / while).
Kutubxona yoki sport zali uchun 4 ta qoida yozing (must be / should be / can’t be + V3).
Kutubxonaga a’zo bo‘lish haqida qisqa suhbat (A2 daraja).
Kvartira ijarasi bo‘yicha agent bilan suhbat (B1 daraja, IELTS Part 1 uslubida).
Kvartira kichik. Ammo metroga juda yaqin.
Leksik zanjir — sinonimlar va umumiy-xususiy so‘zlar: “smartphones → these devices → such technology”. such + ot — “bunday”: “Such measures are rarely popular.”
Let’s + fe’l / Why don’t we + fe’l?
Level: A1, A2, B1, B2 yoki C1
Lexical Resource: 'good' va 'a lot' kabi umumiy so'zlar bandni pasaytiradi.

Lexical Resource’da 7+ uchun “less common” so‘zlar va collocationlar kerak, lekin TABIIY ishlatilishi shart. good → fantastic, rewarding, worthwhile; bad → disappointing, stressful; like → be keen on, be into.

Lexical Resource’da baholanadi: so‘zlar xilma-xilligi, aniqligi va uslubga mosligi. Norasmiy so‘zlar: a lot of → a large number of / a significant amount of; get → obtain/become; kids → children; thing → factor/issue; big → significant/major.
Linkerlarni aniq vazifasi bilan ishlating: However (qarama-qarshilik), Therefore (natija), For instance (misol). Har abzatsda 2–3 tadan ko‘p bo‘lmasin. Har abzats bitta markaziy fikr atrofida.
Linking so‘zlarni haddan ortiq ishlatmay, olmosh va sinonimlar (this, such, these measures) bilan matnni silliq bog‘laysiz.
Listening bo‘limining 4 qismi, vaqti va “bir marta eshitiladi” qoidasini bilasiz va savollarni oldindan o‘qishni odat qilasiz.
Listening test savollarida ko‘pincha UCHALA variant ham audioda tilga olinadi — lekin faqat bittasi savolga to‘g‘ri javob. Qolganlari rad etiladi, o‘tmishga tegishli yoki boshqa narsa haqida.
Listening va Reading bepul. Writing va Speaking’ni AI baholashi tarifingizga kiradi.

Listening: 4 qism, jami 40 savol, taxminan 30 daqiqa. 1-qism — kundalik suhbat (masalan, ro‘yxatdan o‘tish), 2-qism — bir kishining kundalik mavzudagi nutqi, 3-qism — o‘quv mavzusidagi suhbat (talabalar va o‘qituvchi), 4-qism — ma’ruza (lecture). Qismlar qiyinlashib boradi.
Listening’da birinchi eshitilgan javob har doim to‘g‘ri emas.
Listening’da imlo hisobga olinadi. Ko‘plik -s ni tekshiring.
Listening’da so‘zlovchi o‘zini tuzatadi. Oxirgi variantni kuting.
Londonda yashashga ko‘nikishim uchun bir yil kerak bo‘ldi.
Londondagi do‘stingiz Emma yozda O‘zbekistonga kelmoqchi ekanini yozdi. Unga javob e-mail yozing: minnatdorchilik, 1–2 yangilik, kamida 1 savol va norasmiy yakun.
Loyiha jadvaldan orqada. Shunday bo‘lsa ham, sifatni pasaytirmasligimiz kerak.
Loyiha kutilganidan qimmatga tushishi ehtimoldan xoli emas.
Loyiha taqdimoti: ehtimolni aniq darajada aytish, amalga oshmagan rejalarni tushuntirish, rasmiy kelishuvlarni e’lon qilish.
Loyihani rejalashtirish: nima uchun qilyapmiz, qadamlarni qanday bajaramiz va nima bo‘lgandan keyin nima qilamiz.
Loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lgani uning aybi emas edi.
Lyukni yopish va klapanni tekshirish buyrug‘i
Madina — ayol: she. O‘zbekcha “u” ni he deb tarjima qilmang.
Magistratura arizasi, ilmiy maqola yoki IELTS essesi: fikrni lo‘nda yozish, manbalarni o‘zaro bog‘lash va akademik uslubni saqlash.
Mahallangizda yangi bog‘ (park) qurilishi haqida 3–4 gap yozing: kamida bitta ot yasovchi (-ment / -tion / -ness / -ity) va bitta sifat yasovchi (-ful / -less / -ive / -al) qo‘shimchali so‘z.
Mahallangizni tasvirlang: 3 ta gap, there is va there are bilan.
Majburiyat (must / have to), taqiq (mustn’t) va zarurat yo‘qligini (don’t have to) to‘g‘ri farqlaysiz.
Majburlamoq va ruxsat bermoq: make, let, allow
Majhul + modal: must be done, needs to be checked
Majhul + oldin — to have been built.
Majhul nisbat o'tgan zamonda: was/were + V3 (published).
Majhul nisbat: to be + V3. Kim qilgani muhim bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi.
Majhul: to be + V3 (She hopes to be chosen), being + V3 (I don’t like being watched). Birlashgan: to have been + V3 — “The painting is thought to have been stolen in 1990.”
Majhulda make ham to oladi: “I was made to wait.” let majhul shaklda ishlatilmaydi — o‘rniga be allowed to: “I was allowed to go” (I was let to go — xato).
Maktab dasturi, amaliy ko‘nikmalar, kasb-hunar ta‘limi, tanqidiy fikrlash.
Maktab yoki ish joyingiz uchun rasmiy tavsiya yozing: recommend / suggest / insist that … va It is essential that … dan keyin fe’lning asosiy shaklini ishlating.
Maktabda yaxshiroq o‘qiganimda, hozir yaxshiroq ishim bo‘lardi.
Maktabdagi yoki uydagi qoidalarni eslang: ota-onangiz yoki o‘qituvchilar sizga nima qildirgan, nimaga ruxsat bergan, nima taqiqlangan edi.
Maktabim yaqin, shuning uchun piyoda boraman.
Maktablar tazyiq va haqoratni kamaytirish uchun choralar ko‘rishi kerak.
Manbalarni sintez qilish: Both X and Y…, consistent with…
Manbani baholashda says o‘rniga contend, acknowledge, refute, dismiss, imply / infer kabi aniq fe’llarni ma’nosiga mos tanlaysiz.
Manbasi aniq bo‘lmagan yoki umumiy fikrlarni masofa saqlab, rasmiy uslubda yetkazasiz.
Manzilni topganimda yig‘ilish tugab bo‘lgan edi.
Map/plan savolida gapiruvchi bir joydan boshlab yo‘l ko‘rsatadi. Avval xaritada “siz shu yerdasiz” belgisi va kirish joyini toping — tushuntirish shu yerdan boshlanadi.
Maqol, idioma va kollokatsiyani bir-biridan farqlaysiz va maqolni nutqda (qisqartirilgan shaklda ham) o‘rinli ishlatasiz.
Maqol: butun umidni bitta narsaga bog‘lama.
Maqsad: in order to, so that
Maqsadga qarab kunlik reja va tavsiyalar o‘zgaradi. Hozir tavsiya:
Maqsadingizni tanlaysiz, 3 daqiqalik test darajangizni aniqlaydi.
Maqsadni to, in order to, so as (not) to va so that bilan aniq ifodalaysiz.
Markazdan uzoq bo‘lgani uchun mehmonxonadan voz kechdik.
Masalan, deyarli barcha yirik kompaniyalar poytaxtda joylashgan.
Masalan, katta shahardagi xodim kuniga ikki soat tejashi mumkin.
Masalan, yakshanbalari oilam uchun tez-tez palov qilaman.
Masalan: 2 ta dars qil; misollarni Toshkent hayotidan ol
Mashg‘ulotni yoqtirish haqida gapirganda like, love, hate dan keyin fe’lga -ing qo‘shamiz: I like swimming. She loves dancing.
Mashina bilan kichkinagina muammo bo‘ldi (aslida jiddiy).
Mashina uyda — ishda bo‘lishi mumkin emas.
Mashq qilgan sari o‘sish shu yerda ko‘rinadi.
Maslahat so‘rash: What should I do?
Maslahat: If I were you, I would…
Maslahat: had better, ought to, Why don’t you…?
Maslahat: should + oddiy fe’l: You should see a doctor. Barcha egalar uchun bir xil, -s va to qo‘shilmaydi.
Masofadan ishlash yosh mutaxassislar orasida ommalashdi.
Matching features: bayonotni odam, kompaniya yoki yilga moslashtirish (A Dr Smith, B Prof. Lee…). Avval matnda barcha ismlarni scan qilib belgilang, keyin har ism atrofidagi fikrni o‘qing.

Matching information: “Which paragraph contains… a definition / an example / a comparison?” Javoblar matn tartibida KELMAYDI va bitta abzats bir necha marta ishlatilishi mumkin. Shuning uchun savol turiga (example, reason, comparison) e’tibor bering.
Matn bog‘liqligi: the former / the latter, this issue
Matn va savollar, taymer, dalil izohlari
Matn: soat 8 da ochiladi. Gap: ertalab ochiladi → TRUE.
Matnda mashhurlik haqida gap yo‘q → NOT GIVEN.
Matndan aynan va bitta so‘z: rare.
Matndan ikki so‘zdan ko‘p bo‘lmagan javob yozing.
Matnni so‘zma-so‘z emas, maqsad bilan o‘qiysiz: umumiy g‘oya uchun skimming, aniq ma’lumot uchun scanning.
Mavzu gapi aniq bo‘lsin: “One major advantage of working from home is that employees save time.” Keyin “This is because…” bilan tushuntiring, “For example, …” bilan misol keltiring.
Mavzu tanlang: savol, reja, namuna va kalit so‘zlar.

Mavzu: shahar markaziga mashina kirishini cheklash. 4–5 gaplik qisqa abzats yozing: kamida bitta “this/these/such + ot” va bitta aniq linker (However / Therefore). “Moreover”ni ikki martadan ko‘p ishlatmang.
May oyida qor yog‘ishi ehtimoli kam — unlikely.

Mazmunni ham taxmin qiling: “Bring your ___ to the first class” — ehtimol hujjat yoki narsa (passport, photo, ID card). Taxmin qilgan so‘z to‘g‘ri chiqmasligi mumkin, lekin quloq nimani kutishni biladi.

Ma’lum muddatgacha tugaydigan o‘zgarish uchun future perfect: “By 2030, the figure will have doubled.” by + yil = “… yilga kelib”. IELTS da zamon xatosi butun javob bo‘ylab takrorlanadi va Grammatical Range and Accuracy bahosini tushiradi, shuning uchun yozishdan oldin grafikning vaqt oralig‘ini tekshiring.
Ma’lum paytda davom etadi: will be + -ing.
Ma’lum qismni gap boshiga chiqarib (fronting), matnda bog‘lanish va ta’kid yaratasiz.
Ma’lumot (2023): smartfon egalari — Koreya 95%, Germaniya 80%, Hindiston 45%, Nigeriya 40%. 3–4 gap bilan taqqoslang: whereas, twice as / just under half / the highest.
Ma’lumot uchun zamonlar: rose, has risen, is expected to
Ma’lumot va g‘oyalar (matn va grafiklardan xulosa)

Ma’lumot: 2000–2020 yillarda shahardagi velosipedchilar soni 3 baravar oshdi, avtomobilchilar soni biroz kamaydi, avtobus esa eng ommabop bo‘lib qoldi. Kirish gapi va “Overall” bilan overview yozing (sonlarsiz).
Ma’lumot: kinoteatrga tashrif 2010 da 5 mln → 2015 da 2 mln; onlayn tomosha 1 mln → 9 mln; teatr 1 mln atrofida barqaror. 3 ta trendni tasvirlang (fe’l + ravish + predlog).
Ma’lumotlar ekran oldidagi vaqt bilan yomon uyqu o‘rtasida bog‘liqlik borligini ko‘rsatadi, ammo bevosita sababni emas.
Ma’lumotlar to‘liq bo‘lmagani uchun natijalar hali taxminiy.

Ma’no beruvchi old qo‘shimchalar: mis- (noto‘g‘ri): misunderstand, mislead; over- (haddan ortiq): overestimate, overcrowded; under- (yetarli emas): underpaid, underestimate; re- (qaytadan): rewrite, rebuild. IELTS Speaking’da “not honest, not fair” o‘rniga dishonest, unfair kabi bitta so‘z nutqni ixcham va tabiiy qiladi.

Ma’no nozikligi: account for ikki ma’noli — “Women account for 60% of students” (tashkil etadi) va “This accounts for the rise” (o‘sishning sababini tushuntiradi). O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining xatosi — yuklamani tushirib qoldirish: “carry research” emas, carry out research. Olmosh o‘rtada turadi: rule it out (rule out it emas).
Ma’no o‘zgaradi: remember doing / remember to do

Ma’nosi deyarli bir xil; might biroz kamroq ishonchni bildiradi. Inkor: may not / might not (“He might not come” — kelmasligi mumkin). could not esa “bo‘lishi mumkin emas” ma’nosiga yaqin, uni ehtiyot bilan ishlating.
Ma’nosi tushunarli, so‘zlar tabiiy birikadi — kollokatsiya.
Ma’ruzadagi signposting so‘zlari (firstly, turning to, however, to sum up) orqali qayerda ekaningizni bilib, konspektni to‘ldirasiz.
Mehmon xonadagi shovqin va ishlamaydigan konditsioner haqida shikoyat qilmoqda.
Mehmonlar uchun xarid ro‘yxatini gap bilan yozing: a lot of, a few, a little dan foydalaning.
Mehmonxona qabulxonasiga 3 ta muloyim savol yozing (Could you tell me…, Do you know…, … if…).
Mehmonxona unchalik hashamatli emas edi (aslida yomon edi).
Mehmonxonada xona band qilish bo‘yicha qisqa telefon suhbati (A2 daraja).
Men 18 yoshdan oshganman va qattiq so‘kishni o‘zim xohlayman
Men Sellzen’da ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman — sen ham qo‘shil:
Men bu fikrga ikki asosiy sababga ko‘ra to‘liq qo‘shilaman.
Men ham: So do I / Neither do I
Men maktabga har kuni avtobusda boraman.
Men o‘zbekcha, ruscha va biroz inglizcha gapira olaman.
Men spent more ______ women on sport. (dan ko‘ra)
Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman.
Men uchun qilgan hamma narsangizni chindan ham qadrlayman.
Men unga uy vazifasida tez-tez yordam beraman.
Men, sen, u, biz, ular: kishilik olmoshlari
Mendan jahling chiqmasin — telefonimni quvvatlashni unutibman.
Menejer yig‘ilishni keyinga qoldirishni taklif qildi.
Menga maslahat bera olarmikansiz, deb o‘ylab turgandim.
Menga nima qilish kerakligini aytishlarini yoqtirmayman.
Meni, uni, bizni: me, him, her, us, them
Menimcha, har kuni fast-fud yemasligingiz kerak.
Menimcha, ikkala shaharni ham ko‘rishga vaqtimiz yetmaydi.
Menimcha, ko‘p do‘konlar asosiy ko‘chalardan yo‘qolib ketishi mumkin.
Menimcha, ko‘pchilik yoshlar shaharni afzal ko‘radi, asosan ish imkoniyatlari tufayli.
Mening ikkita akam (ukam) va bitta opam (singlim) bor.
Messi to‘pni oladi, uzatadi, zarba beradi — gol!

Mezonlar (har biri 25%): Fluency & Coherence — ravon va bog‘langan nutq; Lexical Resource — so‘z boyligi; Grammatical Range & Accuracy; Pronunciation — tushunarli talaffuz. Aksent baholanmaydi — tushunarlilik baholanadi.
Migratsiya, malakali kadrlar oqimi, rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlar, turmush darajasi.
Mijoz kafeda buyurtma bergan, lekin boshqa narsa keltirishgan.
Mijozlarga rasmiy e’lon yozing (masalan, xizmat vaqtincha to‘xtashi haqida): Should …, Were … to … va Had … tuzilmalaridan kamida ikkitasini ishlating.
Mikrofonga ruxsat berilmagan. Brauzer sozlamalarida ruxsat bering.
Minora endi poydevor qo‘ydi. Keyingi safar birinchi gapni oldindan o‘ylab qo‘ying va to‘xtamang!
Misol: Social media causes depression. → Excessive use of social media may contribute to depression in some teenagers.
Misol: “Many people believe that technology makes us lonely.” → “It is widely believed that technology leads to isolation.” → “The belief that technology fosters loneliness is widespread.”
Mock Arena: barcha Reading va Listening testlari — cheksiz
Mock natijasi uchun kamida 2 ta ko‘nikma kerak.
Mock testlar bepul. AI baho: haftasiga {0} ta Writing va {1} ta Speaking bepul.
Mock testlar bepul. Obuna — cheksiz darslar, AI baho va AI ustoz.
Modal + be + V3: must be done, should be checked, can be used, will be sent. Qoidalar va rasmiy ko‘rsatmalarda juda ko‘p: “Mobile phones must be switched off.”
Modal fe’llar va infinitiv bilan majhul nisbatni (must be signed, wants to be told) qoidalar va talablarni yozishda ishlatasiz.
Modal perfect continuous (must have been -ing) va future perfect continuous (will have been -ing) bilan davomiylik va taxminni aniq ifodalaysiz.
Mozart hayot emas — tugagan davr: Past Simple.
Muallif ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yolg‘izlikni kuchaytiradi, deb ta’kidlaydi.
Muallif o‘z fikrini aytmagan → NOT GIVEN.
Muallif uy vazifasi qisqaroq bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi.
Mualliflar tanlanma kichik bo‘lganini ta’kidlab o‘tadi.
Muammo-yechim savolida asosiy e’tiborni g‘oyalarga qarating
Muammo-yechim savolida o‘z fikringizni yozib, yechimni unutish.
Muammodan xabarim bo‘lganida, yordam bergan bo‘lardim.
Muddat qisqa — maqsad yoki sanani o‘zgartiring.
Muhim bir kun yoki joyni tasvirlang: kamida bir marta joy + fe’l + ega (On the hill stood…) va So … was … that / Such was … that tuzilmasini ishlating.

Muhim farq: o‘zbek tilida “Menimcha, bu yaxshi emas” deymiz — inkor ikkinchi qismda turadi. Inglizchada esa odatda inkor think ga o‘tadi: I don’t think it’s a good idea. (“I think it isn’t a good idea” grammatik xato emas, lekin g‘ayritabiiy eshitiladi.) Fikr so‘rash: What do you think (of / about) …? How do you feel about …?
Muhim kunga (imtihon, intervyu) tayyorgarligingizni yozing: nimaga majbur bo‘ldingiz, nima shart emas edi, nimani behuda qildingiz.
Muhim qoida: does ishlatilganda asosiy fe’l -s olmaydi! “Does she works?” — xato, “Does she work?” — to‘g‘ri. -s allaqachon does da bor.
Muhim: ikkinchi qismda gap tartibi oddiy gapdagidek — ega + fe’l: where the station IS (where is the station emas). do / does / did yo‘qoladi: “Do you know where he lives?” (where does he live emas).
Muloyim e’tiroz: I’m not sure about that.
Muloyim iltimos: Could you…? (Can you… ham to‘g‘ri).
Muloyim iltimos: Could you…? Could I…?
Muloyim rad etish: “I’m sorry, I can’t. I’m busy on Saturday.” “I’d love to, but I have to work.” Faqat “No” deyish qo‘pol eshitiladi.
Muloyim rad: I’m sorry, I can’t + sabab.
Muloyim savol: Could you tell me where…?
Muloyim savol: Will you be using the car tonight? (Rejangizni so‘rash, iltimos qilishdan oldin.)
Muloyim savol: Will you be using…?
Muloyimlik uchun o‘tgan zamon: I was wondering if…
Munozara va esse: tinglovchini ishontirish, jonli og‘zaki nutq va mantiqiy aniq yozma bog‘lanish.
Munozara: sun’iy intellekt va ish o‘rinlari
Munozarada fikr bildirish: kuchli sifatlar, umumlashtirish va fikrni muvozanatli tuzish.
Munozarali mavzuda ehtiyotkor, mantiqiy va boy tilda fikr bildirish — IELTS Writing Task 2 va Speaking Part 3 uchun asosiy ko‘nikma.
Muntazam sport bilan shug‘ullanadigan odamlar yaxshiroq uxlaydi.
Murakkab esse va nutqda fikrlarni nozik bog‘lash: yon berish, fikrni ot sifatida qurish, matn bog‘liqligi.
Murakkab matnlarni tushunasiz. Maqsad: ball va aniqlik.
Murakkab old va orqa qo‘shimchalar (counter-, mis-, over-, under-, -ise, -ity, -wise) bilan yangi so‘zlarni yasaysiz va tushunasiz.
Musiqa asboblari bilan 'play the ...' qolipi ishlatiladi.
Mustahkam minora! Endi oltin g‘ishtlarni — because, however, for example — ko‘proq ishlating.
Mutaxassisimiz rejangizni tushuntirib beradi va savollaringizga javob beradi.
Muvaffaqiyatsiz loyiha haqida tahliliy paragraf yozing: kamida 4 ta yasama so‘z (underestimate, counterproductive, prioritise, -wise…).
Muvaffaqiyatsiz yakunlangan voqea (ish, sayohat) haqida xushmuomala e’lon yoki xat yozing: evfemizm va understatement bilan.
Muvozanatli fikr: on the other hand, having said that
Muzey bo‘ylab ekskursiya oldidan ma’lumot (B1 daraja, IELTS Part 2 uslubida).
Muzeydan o‘g‘irlangan rasm haqida yangilik yozing: seem / be believed to have…, having + V3 va majhul shakllar bilan.
My friends and I = we → oddiy shakl: play.
My grandfather has got a white ___. (soqol)
My name — bitta narsa (ism), shuning uchun is.
NIMA?! “{wrong}”?! Ahmoq, miyang bormi o‘zi?! To‘g‘risi “{right}”, yodla!
NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS kabi ko‘rsatmalarga amal qilib, matndagi so‘zni grammatik to‘g‘ri va xatosiz yozasiz.
NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqida ma’lumot YO‘Q: na tasdiqlanadi, na rad etiladi. Eng ko‘p xato: o‘zingiz bilgan yoki mantiqiy tuyulgan narsani TRUE deb belgilash. Faqat matnga ishoning!
Nafis yon berish: much as, hard as it is
Namuna barcha sinovlardan o‘tolmadi, shuning uchun hammasini boshidan boshlashga to‘g‘ri keldi.
Namuna bilan solishtiring: «{0}». Boshqa to‘g‘ri variant ham bo‘lishi mumkin.
Naqdmi yoki kartami? — Karta bilan, iltimos.
Narsa bilan -ing kerak emas: I love ice cream.
Narsa haqida -ing kerak emas: I like pizza. I love my city. Inkor: I don’t like getting up early. She doesn’t like cooking.
Narsa: that / which (bu yerda tushirib qoldirish ham mumkin).
Narsani ko‘rsatib: “This is a pen.” (Bu — ruchka.) O‘zbek tilida “bir” so‘zi shart emas, ingliz tilida esa bitta narsadan oldin a yoki an kerak. “This is pen” — xato.
Narx haqida fikr yo‘q → NOT GIVEN.
Narx savoli: How much is + narsa?
Narx so‘rash: How much is + narsa.
Narx so‘rash: How much is this? / How much are these shoes? Sanalmaydigan narsani sanash uchun idish yoki birlik ishlatiladi: a bottle of water, a kilo of rice, a loaf of bread.
Narx so‘rash: bitta narsa — How much is this T-shirt? Ko‘p yoki juft narsa — How much are these shoes? Javob: It’s fifteen pounds. / They’re forty dollars.
Natija (yangi gap yoki nuqtali vergul bilan): therefore, consequently, as a result, thus: The price rose. Consequently, demand fell.
Natija + ot: lead to, result in, cause: Pollution can lead to health problems. Xato: “result to”, “lead in”.
Natija va soni uchun present perfect simple, jarayon va davomiylik uchun present perfect continuous’ni tanlaysiz.
Natija yoki jarayon? (present perfect vs continuous)
Natija — yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan.
Natijada ularda ish uchun ko‘proq kuch qoladi.
Natijalar aniq xulosa bermadi, shuning uchun qo‘shimcha tadqiqot zarur.
Navbat sizda — endi siz harakat qilasiz.
Navoiyni o‘zbek adabiyotidagi eng buyuk shoir desa bo‘ladi.
Nazariya qabul qilingan — demak keyingi tadqiqotlar uni tasdiqlagan: corroborated.
Nechta talaba topshirgani aytilmagan — qolganlar haqida bilmaymiz → NOT GIVEN.
Nega ba’zi odamlar ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko‘radi?
Never / Rarely / Seldom + aux + ega + fe’l
Never, Rarely, Seldom, Not only, Hardly … when, No sooner … than, Under no circumstances, Only then kabi so‘zlar gap boshiga chiqsa, savoldagi kabi tartib bo‘ladi: yordamchi fe’l + ega + asosiy fe’l.
New schools are needed to ___ the growing demand for places. (qondirmoq)
Nihoyat, yarim tunda Buxoroga yetib keldik.
Nima, kim pishiradi, qachon yeysiz, nega yoqadi.
Nimalarni qila olishingiz va qila olmasligingiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing (can / can’t).
Nimalarni yaxshi ko‘rasiz va nimalarni yoqtirmaysiz? 3–4 gap yozing (love / like / hate + -ing).
Nisbiy gap: the film + that + we watched ... + was ...
Nisbiy gaplar: who, which, that, where, whose
Nisbiy olmosh ega bo‘lmasa (to‘ldiruvchi bo‘lsa), aniqlovchi gapda uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin: The book (that) I bought is great. Xato: “The book that I bought it” — ortiqcha it.
No sooner + had + ega + V3 … than.
Noaniq so'zlarni ('good', 'a lot') aniq so'zlar bilan almashtiring.
Noaniq til: sort of, or so, -ish, and whatnot

Nominal gap — butun gap ot o‘rnida turadi. what-gap to‘ldiruvchi yoki ega bo‘ladi: “I can’t believe what he said.” “What she suggested made sense.” (C1 dagi “What I need is…” — cleft, urg‘u uchun; bu yerda esa what-gap oddiy ot vazifasida.)
Nomzod marketing menejeri lavozimi uchun suhbatda.
Non, pishloq, meva va shunga o‘xshash narsalar oldik.
Noqulay mavzularni evfemizmlar bilan muloyim aytasiz va understatement (not exactly, a bit of) orqali nozik tanqid qilasiz.

Norasmiy e-mail (do‘st, qarindoshga) tuzilishi: 1) salomlashish — Hi Sarah, / Dear Sarah,; 2) kirish — Thanks for your email. It was great to hear from you.; 3) asosiy qism — yangiliklar va savollarga javob; 4) yakun — I can’t wait to see you. Write back soon!; 5) xayrlashuv — Best wishes, / Love, / See you soon, + ismingiz.
Norasmiy e-mail: Thanks for your email…
Norasmiy matnni akademik uslubda qayta yozing: “Lots of kids don’t do enough sport, and that’s a big thing. They get fat and it’s bad for their health. Schools can’t do much.”
Norasmiy so‘zlar (nice, kids, a lot of, stuff)
Norasmiy so‘zlarni (a lot of, get, kids, thing) akademik muqobillar bilan almashtirasiz va so‘z takrorini kamaytirasiz.
Norasmiy uslub: phrasal verb, qisqartma (it’s, don’t), shaxsiy olmosh, oddiy so‘zlar: “We need to find out why sales went down.”

Norasmiy uslubda qisqartmalar (I’m, can’t), oddiy so‘zlar va so‘zlashuv bog‘lovchilari ishlatiladi: Anyway, … (mavzuni o‘zgartirish), By the way, … (aytgancha), Guess what? (bilasanmi nima bo‘ldi?). Rasmiy iboralar (I am writing to inform you…, Yours faithfully) do‘stga g‘alati eshitiladi.
Norasmiy: Do‘kon qachon ochilishini bilib bera olasanmi?
Noreal holatlarni it’s (high) time, as if / as though va suppose / supposing bilan ifodalaysiz.
Not Given — matnda aytilmagan degani. Jim matn "True" degani emas.
Not only + aux + ega …, but … also
Notanish odamdan muloyim so‘rash, suhbatni davom ettirish va fikrga qo‘shilish.
Noto‘g‘ri shakllar: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst; far → further → the furthest.

Nusxalang va Telegram, Instagram yoki TikTok’da ulashing — havolangiz matn ichida. Eng yaxshi natija: o‘z daraja testi natijangizni yoki mock balingizni ko‘rsatib, obunachilarni bellashuvga chaqirish.
Nusxalar server diski ichida: disk yo‘qolsa, ular ham yo‘qoladi. BACKUP_S3_* sozlang.

Nutq tartibi: kirish gap (“I’d like to talk about…”), har nuqta navbat bilan, bog‘lovchilar (First of all, After that, What I liked most was…). Ko‘pincha o‘tgan zamon kerak bo‘ladi. Imtihonchi to‘xtatguncha gapirishda davom eting.
Nutq tezligi past. Fikrni to‘xtamasdan davom ettirishga harakat qiling.
Nutqni tanib bo‘lmadi, qayta urinib ko‘ring.
Nutqni tanish internet talab qiladi, aloqa yo‘q
Nutqni tanish to‘xtab qoldi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring.
Nutqni tanish xizmati bilan aloqa yo‘q.
O'tgan zamon aniq vaqt (yesterday), majhul nisbat: was + V3.
O'tgan zamon belgisi (yesterday) bilan fe'l ham o'tgan zamonda bo'lishi kerak.
O'tgan zamon fe'li topilmadi (went, watched, was ...).
O'tgan zamon inkori: did not (didn't) + fe'l asl shaklda.
O'tgan zamon savoli: Did + ega + fe'l asl shaklda.
O'tgan zamon savoli: did + ega + fe'l (buy, bought emas).
O'tgan zamon: go → went. 'to the cinema' (artikl 'the' bilan).
O'tgan zamon: oddiy fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi: watched.
O'tmishdagi ikki voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgani uchun Past Perfect (had + V3).
O'tmishdagi xayoliy holat (Third Conditional): If + had + V3, would have + V3.
O'zgarishni aytganda Present Perfect (has changed, has been built) ishlating.
O'zingiz haqingizda 'in my opinion' / 'I think' deyiladi. 'According to' boshqa manba uchun.
Ob-havoni It’s cold / It’s sunny bilan aytasiz va fasllar haqida In winter it snows kabi gap tuzasiz.
Obuna avtomatik yangilanmaydi — muddat tugagach, xohlasangiz qayta to‘laysiz.
Obuna hisobingizga bog‘lanadi. Avval hisobingizga kiring.
Obuna hisobingizga yoziladi: boshqa qurilmada ham shu hisob bilan kirasiz.
Obunasiz o‘quvchilar uchun kunlik va haftalik chegaralar.
Ochiq to‘lovlaringiz ko‘p. Avval bittasini yakunlang yoki bekor qiling.
Odam yoki narsani ko‘rsatib, to‘g‘ri olmoshni (he, she, it, they) tanlaysiz: He is a boy. It is a book.

Odam yo‘q bo‘lsa: I’m sorry, she’s not here at the moment. Can I take a message? Qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan odam: Could you ask her to call me back? Farqiga e’tibor bering: xabarni qabul qilgan odam take a message, qoldirgan odam esa leave a message deydi.
Odam, narsa, joyni aniqlash uchun who / which / that / where / whose bilan ergash gap tuzasiz; aniqlovchi va qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi turlarini ajratasiz.
Odamlar haqida umumiy gapiring: “people”, “young people”, “in many countries”. Faqat “I” dan foydalanmang — 3-qism jamiyat haqida.
Odamlar ilgari xat yozishardi, hozir esa xabar yuborishadi.
Odamlar oziq-ovqat, turizm va to‘lqindan himoya uchun bog‘liq
Odamlarni baxtli qiladigan narsa pul emas.
Odamlarni va his-tuyg‘ularni tasvirlash: kim qanday ishlaydi, nima zeriktiradi, bu kimniki.
Odamlarning mutlaq ko‘pchiligi yangi qonunni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.
Odamni so‘rash: Can I speak to …?
Odamning tashqi ko‘rinishini be (He is tall) va have got (She has got blue eyes) bilan tasvirlaysiz.
Odat uchun 'am' kerak emas. O'zbekcha 'men o'qiyapman' deb o'ylab, 'am study' deb xato qilinadi.
Odat uchun present simple, hozirgi harakat uchun present continuous’ni tanlaysiz; know, like, want kabi fe’llarni -ing siz ishlatasiz.
Odatda avtobusda yuraman, lekin bugun piyoda ketyapman.
Odatiy harakat: Present Simple. 'She' bilan fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi.
Odatiy kuningiz va hozir (bugun) qilayotgan ishlaringizni taqqoslang: 2 ta present simple, 2 ta present continuous.
Odatiy suhbat: avval Present Perfect bilan umumiy savol, keyin tafsilot Past Simple’da: “Have you ever been to Bukhara?” — “Yes, I went there last spring.”

Odatiy xatolar: “The study has a lot of mistakes” (mistakes o‘rniga flaws / limitations), “based from” (to‘g‘risi based on), “fail to taking” (fail to + fe’lning asl shakli), “anecdotic” (to‘g‘risi anecdotal evidence — tasodifiy shaxsiy misollar). Inkorni faqat “not reliable” bilan cheklamang: of questionable reliability, open to question kabi ehtiyotkor iboralar akademik uslubga ko‘proq mos keladi.

Odatiy xatolar: “consistent to” (to‘g‘risi — consistent with), “concur to Lee” (to‘g‘risi — concur with Lee), “those of” ni tushirib qoldirish: “Ito’s results echo those of Hall” (Hall’ning natijalarini). Har manba uchun “says” ishlatmang — contend, maintain, demonstrate kabi aniq fe’llarni qo‘llang.
Odatlaringiz haqida 4 ta gap yozing: always, usually, sometimes, never dan foydalaning.
Oddiy (gradable) sifatlar darajaga ega: cold, tired, big, good. Ular very, extremely, a bit bilan keladi: very cold.
Oddiy ma’no: It’s time + to + fe’l.
Oddiy odat/holat uchun 'am' kerak emas: I study, I work, I live.
Oddiy sifatlarni very bilan, kuchli (extreme) sifatlarni absolutely / really bilan kuchaytirasiz.
Oddiy so‘z va iboralarni tushunasiz. Asosiy gaplarni tuzishni o‘rganasiz.
Oddiy so‘zlarni (good, bad, like) aniqroq so‘z va collocationlar bilan almashtirasiz, idiomalarni faqat mos joyda ishlatasiz.
Oddiy: I have never seen such a view. → Inversiya: Never have I seen such a view.
Og‘zaki hikoya va latifalarda o‘tgan voqea ko‘pincha hozirgi zamonda aytiladi — tinglovchi voqea ichida turgandek his qiladi: “So I’m walking down the street, and this man comes up to me and says…”
Og‘zaki nutq belgilari: mind you, anyway, as I was saying
Og‘zaki nutq bog‘lovchilari (actually, to be honest, mind you, what I mean is) bilan fikrlarni silliq ulaysiz va yozma uslubdan qochasiz.

Og‘zaki nutq yozma inshodan farq qiladi. Speaking’da “Furthermore, moreover, in conclusion” g‘alati eshitiladi. Tabiiy bog‘lovchilar: actually, to be honest, I mean, mind you, the thing is, as far as I know, on top of that.
Og‘zaki nutqda qisqa shakllar ko‘p ishlatiladi: I’m, you’re, he’s, she’s, it’s, we’re, they’re.
Og‘zaki nutqda tabiiy noaniqlik iboralari (sort of, or so, -ish, and stuff like that, roughly) bilan yumshoq va tabiiy gapirasiz.
Ohangidan uning norozi ekanini xulosa qildim.
Oila a’zolaringizdan birining kuni haqida 3 ta gap yozing (he yoki she bilan).
Oilam uchun ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko‘raman.
Oilangiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing: nechta aka-uka, opa-singil, bola bor (ko‘plik shakllari bilan).
Oilangiz va do‘stlaringiz haqida gapirish: nechta aka-uka, kim kimni yaxshi ko‘radi, savol berib tanishish.
Oilangizdagi 2 kishi haqida yozing: siz ular bilan nima qilasiz? (him, her, them, me, us dan kamida ikkitasi)
Oilangizdagi 3 kishini tasvirlang: ular nimani qanday qiladi? (-ly ravishlar va well)
Oilangizdagi 3 kishining kasbini yozing (a / an va my / his / her bilan).
Oilangizdagi yoki do‘stlaringizdan biri qanaqa ko‘rinishda? Bo‘yi, sochi va ko‘zlarini tasvirlang.
Oilaviy rasmni tasavvur qiling: 2 ta odam va 1 ta narsa yoki hayvonni ko‘rsatib yozing (This is… He / She / It is…).
Old qo‘shimchalar: unfair, illegal, misunderstand, overestimate
Oldindan o‘ylab qo‘yilgan reja yoki niyat: am / is / are + going to + fe’l. “I’m going to learn to drive this summer.”
Oldindan qilingan reja (chipta olingan): are going to.
Oldindan qilingan reja uchun going to, shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror, va’da va fikrga asoslangan bashorat uchun will ni tanlaysiz.

Oldingi butun fikrni “this + ot” bilan umumlashtirish: “Prices have doubled. This increase has hit poor families hardest.” Umumlashtiruvchi otlar: this issue / trend / problem / approach / development / decision.
Oldingi harakat — Having + V3: Having finished the report, she went home. (= After she had finished…)
Oldingi pog‘onani bajardingiz — yangi pog‘ona ochildi!
Olib chiqdim, behuda — needn’t have taken.
Oliy ta’lim hamma uchun bepul bo‘lishi kerakmi?
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchi kabi jonli gapirish: idiomalar, juft iboralar va muloyim yumshatish.
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar hamma narsani aniq aytmaydi — bu nutqni tabiiy va do‘stona qiladi. Taxminiy son: about, roughly, or so, -ish: “twenty or so people”, “at sevenish”, “around 50%”.
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar kabi ixcham gapirish: keraksiz takrorlarsiz, tabiiy qisqartmalar bilan.

Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar maqolni ko‘pincha qisqartirib aytadi, chunki davomini hamma biladi: “Well, every cloud…” (= every cloud has a silver lining — har yomonlikning bir yaxshi tomoni bor), “When in Rome…” (= do as the Romans do — qayerda bo‘lsang, o‘sha yerning odatiga amal qil). Maqoldan ibora ham yasaladi: a silver lining (yaxshi tomon).
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar suhbatni kichik iboralar bilan boshqaradi. Mavzuni o‘zgartirish: by the way (aytgancha), anyway (xullas, nima bo‘lsa ham — asosiy mavzuga qaytish).
Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar takrorlamaydi. Yordamchi fe’lda to‘xtashadi: “Have you finished?” — “Yes, I have.” (finished takrorlanmaydi) “She can’t swim, but her brother can.”
Onam past bo‘yli, sochlari uzun va qora.
Once + Present Perfect majhul: has been shaped.
Onlayn bank xizmatlari naqd pulsiz iqtisodiyotga yo‘l ochdi.
Onlayn bankingning joriy etilishi odamlarning odatlarini o‘zgartirdi.
Onlayn darslar xususiy darslarchalik qimmat emas.
Onlayn kurslar shahar va qishloq ta’limi o‘rtasidagi tafovutni qisqartirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
Onlayn kurslar sinfdagi darsdek samarali bo‘lishi mumkin.
Onlayn o‘qiganlar sinfda o‘qiganlardan ikki baravar ko‘p edi.
Onlayn ta’lim moslashuvchan. Biroq u intizom talab qiladi.
Opam aeroport yaqinida yashaydi. Shuning uchun doim unikida qolaman.

Orqasidan: predlogli birikma (the increase in prices), qisqargan nisbiy gap — participle (the people living in rural areas, the report published last week), to-infinitive (the decision to close the factory).
Ortiqcha “it” qo‘yilmaydi; what nisbiy olmosh emas.
Orzuingizdagi ish va hamkasblarni tasvirlang: kamida 4 ta qo‘shma sifat (well-paid, open-minded, time-consuming…).
Ot (decline) oldida sifat: a gradual decline.
Ot (increase) oldida sifat keladi: a sharp increase.
Ot + who + fe’l + asosiy gap davomi.
Ot bilan: “The more money he earns, the more he spends.” Sifat bilan: “The older I get, the wiser I feel.” Qisqa shakl: “The sooner, the better.” “The bigger, the better.”
Ota-onam avlodiga qaraganda biz ancha ko‘p sayohat qilamiz.
Otam hech qachon mashinasini haydashga ruxsat bermagan.
Otdan oldin defis qo‘yiladi: a well-known writer. to be dan keyin ko‘pincha defissiz ham yoziladi: The writer is well known. Son + ot birlikda: a two-hour meeting (two-hours emas).
Otlarning ko‘plik shaklini (-s, -es, -ies va children, people kabi istisnolar) to‘g‘ri yozasiz.
Otlashtirish + rasmiy sifat: a considerable increase.
Otni oldidan (sifat, ot) va orqasidan (predlogli birikma, participle) kengaytirib, ma’lumotni bitta zich birikmaga joylaysiz.
Our team ___ (perform) all the others. (o‘zib ketdi)
Overview: necha bosqich, qayerdan boshlanib qayerda tugaydi: “Overall, there are six stages, beginning with … and ending with …”. Tabiiy jarayon (suv aylanishi) bo‘lsa — faol nisbat ham to‘g‘ri.
Overview’siz Task 1 odatda Task Achievement bo‘yicha 5 dan yuqori olmaydi. Overview — eng katta/kichik, umumiy trend (o‘sdimi, kamaydimi), eng katta farq. Unda SONLAR yozilmaydi.
Ovoz eshitildimi? Eshitilmasa, naushnik yoki ovoz balandligini tekshiring.
Ovoz xizmati sozlanmagan: umumiy kunlik chegara belgilanmagan.
Ovozli rejim uchun Chrome yoki Safari kerak — hozircha yozib javob bering.
Ovozli tanish bugun vaqtincha band. Yozib yuboring.
Ovqat juda yaxshi edi, lekin xizmat dahshatli edi.
Ovqat nomlari (breakfast, lunch, dinner) odatda artiklsiz ishlatiladi.
Ovqat pishirishni sinov va xatolar orqali o‘rgandim.
Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: barcha savollarga javob borligini tekshiring (bo‘sh joy = 0 ball), so‘z chegarasi va imloni ko‘rib chiqing. Hech qachon oxirgi matnni boshlamay qoldirmang — oson savollar ham bor.
Oxirgi 30 kunda «{0}» bo‘yicha {1} marta xato qildingiz. «{2}» darsi aynan shu xatoni nishonga oladi.
Oxirgi qadam: telefon raqamingizni ulashing. Hisobingizni himoyalash va kerak bo‘lsa mutaxassisimiz bog‘lanishi uchun.
Oxiri kursni tugatding — kech bo‘lsa ham, hech bo‘lmagandan yaxshi!
Oy nomi katta harf bilan: May.
Oy, kun va soat bilan in / on / at ni adashtirmay ishlatasiz.
Oylik narx; 3 oylik (−10%) va 12 oylik (10 oy narxi) shundan hisoblanadi. Yangi to‘lovlarga qo‘llanadi.
O‘chiq bo‘lsa, /start bosilganda darhol xush kelibsiz xabari keladi (reklama tarmoqlari talabi uchun).
O‘g‘il bolalar matematikada kuchliroq degan fikr shunchaki noto‘g‘ri.
O‘lcham: small, medium, large (S, M, L). Have you got this in a large? — Yes, here you are. Kiyib ko‘rish: Can I try it on? (it — so‘z o‘rtasida: try it on). can bilan iltimos — A1 da o‘rgangansiz.

O‘zbek maqolini so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang: “bir o‘q bilan ikki quyon” inglizchada “kill two birds with one stone” (quyon va o‘q emas — qush va tosh!). IELTS essesida maqol ishlatmang — u yerda siyqa (cliché) eshitiladi; Speaking’da esa bitta o‘rinli maqol tabiiy jaranglaydi.

O‘zbek o‘quvchilar ko‘pincha E va I, G va J harflarini adashtiradi: E — [i:], I — [ay]; G — “ji:”, J — “jey”. Yana bir qoida: ism, familiya, shahar va davlat nomi doim katta harf bilan yoziladi: Aziz Karimov, Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Xato qilsangiz ham qo‘rqmang — mashq qilgan sari oson bo‘ladi!

O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining odatiy xatolari: “Some people say…, but they are wrong” (juda keskin va norasmiy); “In my opinion, I think” (takror); “Although …, but …” (although va but bir gapda kelmaydi — bittasini tanlang). Raddiyadan so‘ng abzasni o‘z pozitsiyangizga qaytarib yakunlang: “Therefore, the advantages of … remain more significant.”

O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining odatiy xatosi — idiomani so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilish yoki o‘xshash iboralarni aralashtirish: “We are on the same side” — “bir tarafdamiz” (boshqa ma’no). Idiomadagi fe’l zamon bo‘yicha o‘zgaradi (She got the ball rolling), qolgan so‘zlar esa o‘zgarmaydi.
O‘zbek tilida bular qo‘shimcha (-da, -ning yonida) bilan beriladi, ingliz tilida esa so‘zdan OLDIN keladi: “the bank next to”, emas “next to the bank”.

O‘zbek tilida muloyimlik ko‘pincha “-sangiz”, “iltimos” bilan beriladi; inglizchada esa savol shakli + please kerak. Buyruq shakli (“Give me the pen”) notanish odamga qo‘pol eshitilishi mumkin. Xato: “Could you to help me?” — could dan keyin to qo‘yilmaydi.

O‘zbek tilida unlining uzun-qisqaligi ma’noni o‘zgartirmaydi, ingliz tilida esa o‘zgartiradi: ship (kema) — sheep (qo‘y), live (yashamoq) — leave (ketmoq). Yana: ba’zi harflar umuman o‘qilmaydi: know (k), write (w), hour (h). Sekin-sekin, ovoz chiqarib takrorlang — quloq tez o‘rganadi.

O‘zbek tilida yo‘q ikkita tovush bor: th. Tilning uchini tishlar orasiga qo‘ying va havo chiqaring: think, three, thank (/θ/). Ovoz bilan aytilsa: this, mother, the (/ð/). “Tank you”, “sink” deyish — eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato.
O‘zbek tilida “-lar” qo‘shamiz, ingliz tilida esa ko‘pincha -s: a book → two books, a sister → three sisters.

O‘zbek tilida “qilmoq” deyarli hamma narsa bilan keladi: xato qilmoq, uy vazifasini qilmoq, harakat qilmoq. Ingliz tilida bu vazifani to‘rt fe’l bo‘lishadi va ularni mantiq bilan emas, tayyor birikma sifatida yodlash kerak. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar: “do a mistake” (to‘g‘risi make a mistake), “make homework” (do homework), “make a photo” (take a photo), “make an exam” (take an exam).

O‘zbek tilidagi “juda” ingliz tilida ko‘pincha “very” bo‘lib qoladi va nutq bir xil eshitiladi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar esa sifatga qarab ma’lum ravishni tanlaydi: highly + likely / unlikely / effective / qualified / recommended; deeply + concerned / moved / rooted; widely + available / accepted / used; bitterly + disappointed / cold; fully / well + aware; entirely / completely + different.

O‘zbek tilidan kalka qilingan xatolar: “solve the threat” (xavf hal qilinmaydi: reduce / eliminate a threat), “do measures” (take measures — “chora ko‘rmoq”), “give attention” (pay attention), “increase the awareness” (raise awareness). Fe’l va ot bir-biriga “yopishgan”, shuning uchun sinonim bilan almashtirib bo‘lmaydi: “carry a threat” yoki “build the gap” deyilmaydi.
O‘zbek va rus tillarida gapira olaman, lekin ingliz tilim unchalik yaxshi emas.
O‘zbekchada qo‘shimcha so‘z oxiriga qo‘shiladi, inglizchada esa predlog gap oxirida “osilib” turadi — bu tabiiy. Predlogni tushirib qoldirmang: “Who are you waiting?” — xato.
O‘zbekchada “Sovuq.” deyish yetadi, ingliz tilida esa gapda ega bo‘lishi shart. Shuning uchun it ishlatiladi: It’s cold. It’s sunny. It’s windy. “Is cold” — xato.
O‘zbekchada “Uning sochi uzun” deymiz — inglizchada ikki yo‘l bor: Her hair is long. yoki She has got long hair. Sifatlar tartibi: avval uzunlik, keyin rang — long black hair, short brown hair.

O‘zbekchadagi “roziman”, “qo‘shilaman” so‘zlari ta’sirida ko‘p o‘quvchi “I am agree” deydi. Aslida agree — fe’l: I agree. I don’t agree (I am not agree emas). Kim bilan: agree with + odam / fikr (I agree with you). Nimaga: agree that + gap (I agree that it’s too expensive).

Passiv = be (kerakli zamonda) + fe’lning 3-shakli. Diqqat bajaruvchiga emas, harakatning o‘ziga yoki natijaga qaratiladi: The bridge was built in 1960.

Past continuous va past simple’ni when / while bilan birlashtirib, uzilib qolgan harakatni hikoya qilasiz.
Past continuous — o‘tgan zamondagi aniq bir paytda davom etayotgan harakat: “At 8 o’clock yesterday I was having dinner.” (Kecha soat 8 da kechki ovqat qilayotgan edim.)
Past perfect — amalga oshmagan umid: “I had hoped to finish by Friday, but…” (umid qilgandim, lekin bo‘lmadi). “Did you want…?” — ofitsiantlar va xizmatda ko‘p ishlatiladigan muloyim savol.
Past perfect — hikoya boshlanishidan oldin bo‘lgan voqea, sabab yoki tushuntirish (He had lost his little daughter).
Past simple (asosiy voqealar), past continuous (fon) va past perfect’ni (oldingi voqea) bitta hikoyada birga ishlatasiz.
Past simple — hikoyaning asosiy voqealari ketma-ket (Suddenly a man ran into the shop and shouted).

Perfect (to have done, having done) va majhul (to be done, being done) infinitiv va gerundlarni seem, appear, deny, regret kabi fe’llardan keyin ishlatasiz.
Perfect gerund — having + V3 — “… qilib bo‘lgach / qilganini”: “Having finished the report, she went home.” “He denied having taken the money.” (taken ham yetarli, having aniqroq).

Perfect infinitiv — to have + V3 — harakat oldinroq bo‘lganini ko‘rsatadi: “He seems to have lost weight.” (u ozganga o‘xshaydi — avval ozgan). seem, appear, be said, be believed, claim, pretend bilan ko‘p.
Phrasal verb = fe’l + kichik so‘z (up, out, on, off, after…). Ma’nosi ko‘pincha alohida so‘zlardan taxmin qilib bo‘lmaydi: give (bermoq) + up = tashlamoq, voz kechmoq.
Piyoda — on foot (by foot emas). Yoki oddiy fe’l bilan: I walk to school. Fe’l bilan ham aytish mumkin: I take the bus. I drive to work.

Predlog oxirida: Who are you talking to?
Predlogdan keyin fe’l -ing shaklida: “They accused him of stealing.” “She succeeded in finding a job.” “I object to being treated like this.”
Predlogdan keyin ham shu shakl: with me, for her, to them. “Come with I” emas — “Come with me”.
Predlogdan keyin har doim -ing: interested in learning, good at speaking, thank you for helping, before leaving.

Predlogdan keyin ot, olmosh yoki fe’lning -ing shakli keladi: She’s good at cooking. I’m worried about him. Tipik xatolar: “good in English” (to‘g‘risi good at English), “angry on me” (to‘g‘risi angry with me), “afraid from dogs” (to‘g‘risi afraid of dogs).
Predloglar: rise TO 50% (yakuniy qiymat), rise BY 10% (farq), FROM 40% TO 50%. “Peak AT 80”. Bu predloglar xatosi juda ko‘p uchraydi — sonni yozishdan oldin tekshiring.

Prefikslar ma’noni o‘zgartiradi: counter- (qarshi): counterproductive; mis- (noto‘g‘ri): misinterpret; over- / under- (ortiq / kam): overestimate, underestimate; out- (o‘zib ketmoq): outnumber, outperform.
Present Perfect = have / has + fe’lning 3-shakli (past participle). U aniq vaqti aytilmagan, hayotda bir paytda bo‘lgan tajribani bildiradi: I have visited Istanbul.
Present Perfect bilan for / since ni davomiylik uchun, already / yet / just ni voqea bo‘lgan-bo‘lmaganini aytish uchun to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
Present Perfect passiv: have been signed.
Present Perfect qisqa javobi: No, they haven’t.
Present Perfect va 'for' yoki 'since' bilan gap tuzing.
Present Perfect — vaqt aytilmagan tajriba yoki hozirgi natija: I have lost my keys (hozir kalitim yo‘q). Ko‘pincha ever, never, already, yet, just, so far bilan keladi.
Present Simple odatlar, har kuni takrorlanadigan ishlar va doimiy faktlar uchun ishlatiladi.
Present Simple — odat (I usually walk to work), Present Continuous — hozir (Today I’m taking a taxi). Ba’zi fe’llar (know, like, want, need) odatda -ing olmaydi: I know (“I am knowing” emas).
Present Simple’da savol va inkor uchun yordamchi fe’l kerak: do (I, you, we, they) yoki does (he, she, it).
Present continuous — hozir, shu payt yoki vaqtinchalik: “I’m working at home this week.” “Look! She’s walking to work today.” Belgilari: now, at the moment, today, this week.
Present simple — odat, doimiy holat, fakt: “I work in a bank.” “She usually walks to work.” Belgilari: usually, every day, never.

Raqamni har gal foiz bilan takrorlamang: 25% = a quarter, 33% = a third, 50% = half, 75% = three quarters; 55–60% = a (small) majority; 10% = one in ten. Yuqori bandli javoblar raqam va so‘zni aralashtiradi: “Just over a third of students (34%) cycled to school.”
Raqamsiz — percentage; percent faqat raqam bilan.
Rasmiy miqdor iboralari: a great deal of, the vast majority
Rasmiy munozara: fikrni bildirish, qarshi dalilga javob berish iboralari — Speaking Part 3 uchun ideal namuna.
Rasmiy natija uchun 4 ta ko‘nikma bali kerak (0–9, 0.5 qadam).
Rasmiy nisbiy iboralar: whereby, in which case, the extent to which
Rasmiy reja va ko‘rsatma: The minister is to visit…

Rasmiy uslub: lotin kelib chiqishli fe’llar, ot birikmalari, majhul nisbat, qisqartmasiz: “It is necessary to ascertain the reasons for the decline in sales.” Juftlar: find out → ascertain / discover, go up → increase, put off → postpone, get → obtain, look into → investigate, set up → establish, ask for → request.

Rasmiy uslub: qisqartmalar yo‘q (don’t → do not), og‘zaki so‘zlar o‘rniga rasmiylari: get → obtain/receive, a lot of → a significant number of / a great deal of, big → considerable, show → demonstrate.
Rasmiy uslubda if tushirib qoldirilib, yordamchi fe’l gap boshiga chiqadi.
Rasmiy uslubda suggest, recommend, insist, demand, require + that + ega + fe’lning asosiy shakli: The doctor recommended that he rest. (rests emas!)
Rasmiy xatlar, akademik matn va murakkab munozarada fikrni nozik farqlar bilan ifodalash: shart inversiyasi, aralash shart gaplar va kuchli kollokatsiyalar.
Rasmiy yozuv, nutq va taqdimotlarda fikrni kuchli va aniq ifodalash: inversiya, ta’kidlovchi (cleft) gaplar va akademik uslub.
Rasmiy, ammo tabiiy ohang: o‘zingizni tanishtirish va kuchli tomonlarni aytish iboralariga e’tibor bering.
Rasmiy: Iltimos, ish vaqtini aniqlab bera olasizmi?
Rasmni tasavvur qiling: notanish odamning xonasi (kitoblar, gitara, sport kiyimi). U haqida 4 ta xulosa yozing (must / can’t / might).
Ravish + sifat birikmalari: highly unlikely, deeply concerned
Ravonlik mukammallikdan muhim. Gapirishda davom eting.

Reading bo‘limining tuzilishi, vaqti va asosiy qoidalarini bilib olasiz — imtihonda kutilmagan narsa qolmaydi.
Reading va Listening darajangizni alohida baholaydi.
Reading va Listening — rasmiy hajm va vaqt bilan. Xatolar izohi bilan.

Real shart (First Conditional): If + Present Simple, will + fe'l. 'If' dan keyin 'will' qo'yilmaydi.

Reja ish beradimi yo‘qmi — buni vaqt ko‘rsatadi.

Reja rad etildi — boshidan boshlaymiz: back to the drawing board.
Reja sizning real darajangizga qurilishi uchun avval daraja testini topshiring.
Reja so‘rash: What are you doing…?
Reja va tayyorgarlik bor: is going to.

Rejadagi ish: be having + narsa + V3.
Rejani so‘rash: What are you doing this weekend? Are you doing anything tonight?

Sabab + ot / -ing: because of, due to, owing to, as a result of: Flights were cancelled due to the storm. Xato: “due to it was raining” — keyin gap kelmaydi (due to the fact that … mumkin).
Sabab + to‘liq gap: because, since, as: Since the price rose, demand fell.
Sabab ham, oqibat (yoki yechim) ham yozilgan
Sabab sifatida faktni hisobga olish: given that / considering that — “… ni hisobga olsak”: “Given that prices are rising, people are saving less.”
Sabab va natija: because, because of, so
Sabab va natija: due to, consequently, therefore
Sabab va oqibatni adashtirmang: sabab "nega bo‘layapti", oqibat "nima bo‘ladi".

Sabab: because + to‘liq gap (ega + fe’l): I stayed at home because it was raining. because of + ot yoki olmosh: I stayed at home because of the rain. Ma’no bir xil, tuzilma esa boshqa. Bu o‘zbek o‘quvchilarining eng ko‘p xatosi: “because of it was raining” yoki “because the rain” — ikkalasi ham xato.
Sabrli va qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Xatoni yumshoq tuzatadi, qisqa gaplar bilan gapiradi.

Sanada tartib son ishlatiladi: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 4th fourth, 5th fifth, 12th twelfth, 20th twentieth, 21st twenty-first.

Sanaladigan ot bilan: twice as many … as.
Sanaladigan otlar (apple, bottle, ticket) ko‘plik oladi va how many bilan so‘raladi: How many tickets do you need?
Sanaladigan otlar: an apple, two apples, an egg, three eggs. Ular bilan a/an va ko‘plik -s ishlatiladi.
Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni ajratib, how much / how many va narx so‘rashni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz.
Sanalar ko‘p shaklda aytiladi: “the third of May”, “May the third”. Javobni bir xil, aniq shaklda yozing: 3 May. Raqamlarni so‘z bilan emas, son bilan yozish xavfsizroq (15, fifteen emas).
Sanalmaydigan narsalarni a bottle of, a piece of, a kilo of kabi birliklar bilan sanaysiz.
Sanalmaydigan ot (water) bilan 'much', sanaladigan ko'plik ot bilan 'many'.
Sanalmaydigan ot bilan fe’l birlikda: “The rice is hot.” Miqdor kerak bo‘lsa — a glass of water, a piece of bread (bu A2 da chuqurroq o‘rganiladi).
Sanalmaydigan otlar (water, rice, bread, money, sugar) ko‘plik olmaydi va how much bilan so‘raladi: How much rice do you want? “breads”, “moneys” — xato.
Sanalmaydigan otlar: water, rice, bread, milk, sugar, money. Ularni “bitta, ikkita” deb sanab bo‘lmaydi: “a rice”, “two breads” — xato.
Sanalmaydigan otni (water, bread, cheese) to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri sanab bo‘lmaydi, lekin idish yoki o‘lchov bilan sanaymiz: a bottle of water, two pieces of bread.

Savdo taxminan 400 dona atrofida barqaror qoldi.
Savol bo‘lsa, shu yerga yozing — jamoamiz javob beradi.
Savol egani so‘rasa (kim qildi?), do / does / did ishlatilmaydi va gap tartibi o‘zgarmaydi: “Who called you?” (Sizga kim qo‘ng‘iroq qildi?) — javob: “Ali called me.”
Savol fikr so‘rasa, “I believe / in my view” ishlating
Savol qatori T, M, H yoki F harfi bilan boshlanadi

Savol tartibi oddiy: where I worked.
Savol tartibi: Are + you + a teacher.
Savol to‘ldiruvchini so‘rasa (kimni? nimani?), do / does / did kerak: “Who did you call?” (Siz kimga qo‘ng‘iroq qildingiz?) — “I called Ali.”
Savol turlari, usullar va vaqt: bilimingizni ballga aylantiring.
Savol tuzish uchun am / is / are ni egadan oldinga chiqaramiz: “You are a student.” → “Are you a student?”
Savol {0} / {1} · g‘alaba uchun kamida {2} ta to‘g‘ri javob
Savol: Have you ever …? (hech qachon … qilganmisiz?) Javob: Yes, I have. / No, I haven’t. never — “hech qachon” ma’nosida, gap ijobiy shaklda qoladi: I have never tried sushi.
Savol: How do you get to work? How does she get to school? Vaqt: How long does it take? — It takes twenty minutes. Diqqat: home oldidan to qo‘yilmaydi: I go home by bus (to home emas).
Savol: How do you spell + narsa?
Savol: Is + ega (your name) + qolgan qism.
Savol: Is there…? / Are there…? Qisqa javob: Yes, there is. / No, there aren’t.
Savol: was / were egadan oldinga chiqadi. “You were at home.” → “Were you at home?”
Savol: “Should governments make public transport free?” Bitta asosiy abzats yozing (PEEL): mavzu gapi, tushuntirish (This is because…), misol (For example…) va natija.

Savol: “Some people think that all university students should study whatever they like. Others believe they should study subjects useful for the future. Discuss both views and give your opinion.” Kirish yozing: paraphrase + thesis (2–3 gap).

Savol: “Some people think that working from home is better than working in an office. To what extent do you agree?” Fikringizcha xulosa abzatsini yozing (2–3 gap): In conclusion + pozitsiya + ikki asosiy fikr qisqacha.
Savolda 'Do' + ega + fe'l: Do you have ...?
Savolda are egadan oldin keladi: Are you…?
Savolda predlog oxirida qoladi: “What are you looking for?” (Nima qidiryapsiz?) “Where are you from?” “What is this book about?”
Savoldagi so‘zlar matnda boshqacha aytilganini (sinonim, boshqa tuzilma) tanib olasiz.
Savollar: so‘z tartibi oddiy gapdagi kabi bo‘ladi va so‘roq belgisi qo‘yilmaydi: “Where do you live?” → He asked where I lived. Ha/yo‘q savollari uchun if / whether: She asked if I was ready.
Savollarni o‘qish vaqtida har bo‘sh joy uchun so‘rang: bu yerga ot keladimi, son keladimi, narxmi, kunmi, joymi? “£___” — narx; “at ___ pm” — vaqt; “a ___” — birlik ot; “on ___” — kun yoki sana.
Savolni belgilash (⚑), matnni bo‘yash va eslatma yozish mumkin. Klaviatura: Alt+N / Alt+P / Alt+F.

Sekin boshlaymiz: har bir gapni eshiting, subtitrga qarab takrorlang. Maqsad — ravon va aniq talaffuz.
